season.evidence: Web search: Mountaineers route page lists June to October, with July through early August the common window and late-August bare ice in low-snow years; the traverse logged ascents fall in August; the stored Jul-Sep window kept.

otherTracksConsidered.why: The only track that reaches Icy Peak (an out-and-back on the same ridge from Ruth, logged as Standard) was on May 23, about five weeks before the traverse season starts, on full snow; also an out-and-back from a camp, not a one-way traverse.
Ruth summit only; never goes south of the Ruth summit.

notes: No in-season track exists that continues over the saddle to Icy Peak. Several Ruth-only reports (including a mid-September one noting scarce water above Hannegan Pass and a receded glacier that can be avoided) belong to the South Slopes route, which already has a track and was not in routes[].
